messages.火傷アタッカーと、味方の精神力回復を兼ねる人格。: An Identity who combines Burn damage with SP recovery for his allies.
messages.火傷で強化: 攻撃スキルは対象の火傷が多いほどコイン威力・ダメージ量が上がる。: **Scales with Burn**: His attack skills gain Coin Power or damage as the target's Burn increases.
messages.S3「剣の流れ」: Ⅳコインで対象の火傷威力だけ憤怒属性ダメージ(最大30)を与: **S3 — Flow of the Sword**: Coin Ⅳ deals Wrath damage equal to the target's Burn Potency, up to 30, then reduces Burn Count by 2. After attacking, restores SP to the 1 ally other than himself with the lowest SP.
messages.守備「炎反」(反撃): 被ダメージ直前に対象の火傷だけバリアを得る(最大10/1: **Defense — Flame Counter**: Immediately before taking damage, gains Shield equal to the target's Burn Potency, up to 10/15, once per turn. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.バトルパッシブ「内なる熱血」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Inner Ardor (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, restores 5 + the highest Resonance SP, up to 10, to the 1 ally with the lowest SP, excluding himself and allies in Panic or E.G.O Corrosion. At 4 or more Wrath Resonance, affects 1 additional ally. Each recipient with a Base Skill that inflicts Burn receives 5 additional SP.
messages.火傷を付与する人格と組み、火傷を積んで火力を伸ばしつつ、パッシブとS3で味方の精: Pair him with Burn Identities to build Burn for his damage while his passive and S3 support allied SP.
messages.炎拳事務所生存者(グレゴール): S1〜S3が火傷を付与する基本スキルなので、パ: **[Firefist Office Survivor](persona:1211) (Gregor)**: His S1–S3 are Base Skills that inflict Burn, making him eligible for the extra SP recovery from Inner Ardor.
messages.南部リウ協会5課(ホンル): 控えに置くと、サポートパッシブで精神力が最も高い味: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604) (Hong Lu)**: On the bench, his support passive increases the Burn Count inflicted by the ally with the highest SP by 1.
